title: How to update
summary: When new patches come out, patch BaconReader again with Reseam Manager: Android updates the app and keeps your login and settings.
body:
- Reseam Manager gets the new patches when it starts, but doesn't patch BaconReader again by itself.
- Then, under **Patched apps**, tap **BaconReader Premium** (or **BaconReader**), then **Patch again**, then **Install → Update**. Reseam Manager patches its own copy of the APK you picked the first time: you don't need to keep the APK.
- The bottom of BaconReader's left menu shows which patches are installed, such as "Patches 0.1.20 (Reseam 0.40.0)".
caption: Updating BaconReader Premium from 0.1.19 to 0.1.20
recorded: Recorded on a Pixel 6 Pro with Reseam Manager 0.41.0.

steps.text: BaconReader patched with Reseam Manager: the bottom of its left menu shows the patches installed, 0.1.19.
New patches came out: open Reseam Manager, which gets them when it starts.
Under Patched apps, tap BaconReader Premium, then Patch again.
Reseam Manager patches it with 0.1.20. Tap Install, then Update: Android keeps your login and settings.
Open BaconReader. Its left menu shows the new patches: 0.1.20.
